expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Only the M1 scaffold was written with the core left to the learner: rtl/blinker.v contains 'TODO(learner): advance `count` and toggle the LED', 'count <= count + 1'b1;  // placeholder: replace me' and 'assign led = 1'b0;  // placeholder: replace me', plus graded hints ('Hint 1... Hint 2... Hint 3'). M2–M7 exist only as plan rows ('| 2 | ALU | ... |'), no implementation files; final answer assigns the work: '你的第一个任务：打开 rtl/blinker.v，让 led 每 BLINK_PERIOD 个周期变化一次——大约 4 行代码'.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Concrete command with expected behaviour: README '运行检查点：make sim' and '预期输出最后一行是 PASS: ...，否则 make 会报 TEST FAILED'; Makefile enforces it: "grep -q '^PASS:' sim/blinker.log || { echo \"TEST FAILED (no PASS line)\"; exit 1; }"; final answer: '跑 make sim 看到 PASS 后，在 PROGRESS.md 勾掉 M1'.

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (processor-riscv-verilog): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones mirror the cited tutorial's actual ladder (upstream link BrunoLevy/learn-fpga FemtoRV/TUTORIALS/FROM_BLINKER_TO_RISCV): M1 闪灯+testbench → M2 ALU → M3 寄存器堆+PC ('x0 恒为 0') → M4 单周期 RV32I 子集 ('译码、立即数、load/store、分支', checkpoint '1+2+…+10 = 55') → M5 存储器+I/O ('内存映射 LED/UART') → M6 riscv-tests 一致性 → M7 五级流水线+CPI. Language pinned to the toolchain: 'Verilog-2001（iverilog -g2001），暂不用 SystemVerilog'; agent read processor-riscv-verilog SKILL.md, tutorial-map.md, concepts.md and the minimal example before planning.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: All 9 shell commands are read-only or write inside the project (mkdir -p rtl tb sim docs; touch .gitkeep; make -n sim; python3 heredoc sim check); tool detection uses command -v only, no install executed. Install is delegated to the learner: '工具链需要你自己装（我这边没有 iverilog，也不代装）：brew install icarus-verilog gtkwave（Ubuntu 用 sudo apt install iverilog gtkwave）'.
